item.title: The Golden Age and Today's Zionism [God, Law, and Liberty]
item.description: Part 2 in the 3 part series on the Golden Age builds on the prophesies of Isaiah and demonstrates the revelation of the new cosmology ushered in by Christ (1 Corinthians 3 is key) and what that means for Zionism and the expection of a future Golden Age.  The direction of the first creation is now "reversed"!

item.title: The "Golden Age" Is Old News Mr. Trump [God, Law, and Liberty]
item.description: Today's episode is the first in a 3-part series pertaining to the "Golden Age" for America that was a popular tag-line upon Trump's inaguration. Don't keep living in a deteriorating and dying cosmology. If you have been steeped in pessimistic theology or think any president might usher in a Golden Age for our nation, these three short podcasts and the scriptures I share are for you.  Look for Part 2 on Wednesday and Part 3 next Friday.
item.author: FLF, LLC

item.itunes:summary: Don't stay suck in an old cosmology of deterioration and death.
